name: 2547.pdf
description: The complete text of Turkey's Higher Education Law (Law No. 2547, 1981), comprehensively governing the structure, governance, and operations of all higher education institutions in Turkey, including the Council of Higher Education (YÖK), university and faculty organizational hierarchies, academic personnel appointments and ranks, student education and admission rules, financial and revolving fund provisions, disciplinary procedures for staff and students, foundation (vakıf) university regulations, and a full record of legislative amendments from 1982 through 2024.
